column1: # The lanes' throwaway test stacks (ADR-142 Amendment 3), one lease each. Read by scripts/stack_lease.sh
# (which containers a holder starts and stops, and the ports it prints) and tests/port_guard.py (which ports
# only that stack's holder may reach). Tab-separated: stack, service, container, host port, the setting a
# test pins it with (- for none; the object store's MINIO_ENDPOINT is given as localhost:<port>), and whether the port guard refuses it to anyone else (yes/no).
# Stack a is the original one (SESSIONS_RUNBOOK.md §4); its lease keeps the old path, stack.lease.
# ClickHouse 18123 is started by test_statelessness_clickhouse.py itself, so that test runs under stack a only.
# Every port is guarded, the object stores included (8 November 2026: an offline run wrote to stack a's
# object store on 9000 while it was unguarded).
# No port here is the owner's deployment's (2480, 5432, 80, 8080, 8081) or airbyte's (8000).
